title: Reverse in Place
hints: Two pointers: `int* lo = arr;` at the front and `int* hi = arr + n;` one past the end. `arr + n` is legal to hold and compare even when `n == 0`; `arr + n - 1` is not.
Loop `while (lo < hi)`. Inside, step `hi` back first (`--hi;`) so it lands on a real element, swap `*lo` and `*hi` with a temporary `int`, then `++lo;`.
